perks.name: Ensemble
perks.desc: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.desc: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.desc: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Quickdraw
perks.desc: This weapon can be drawn unbelievably fast.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.desc: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Moving Target
perks.desc: Increased movement speed and target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Backup Plan
perks.desc: Grants reduced charge time and increased handling speed for a short time immediately after swapping to this weapon.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

notes: [YeezyGT's S18] [MW: Charge/Stab/Handling] "There's something specific Epicurean does which few others do. Quickdraw/Backup Plan is an incredible combo - something akin to a hot-swap that lets you fire a burst off as quickly as a shotgun can. Similarly, Surplus is a nice option that gives more Handling uptime than Quickdraw." tags:pve

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "The Epicurean was always a great alternative to Main Ingredient, and after the two Xur Main Ingredients I would like a little breath of fresh air. The Epicurean can roll feeding frenzy and swashbuckler as its main two perks. While it doesn’t have the best PvE applications it is still a great option" Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Rangefinder is the absolute best in slot perk for the Epicurean. Zoom is the most important thing on fusion rifles. While Main Ingredient still boasts the best in class zoom, the Epicurean can come pretty close. Snapshot sights or surplus will make the Epicurean feel lighter or handle better which is one of its lowest stats. Look for arrowhead brake to clean up the recoil and make those longer ranged voops easier to handle." Recommended MW - Stability.

Inspired by DMB Player Versus Enemies Podcast 18. PvE first-choice roll for general use. Shapeable. To Excess origin perk is most useful with Tier 4/5 supers with the shortest cooldown, but can add to melee/grenade builds. There are better void fusion rifles available but, if you must, use stability to constrain bolt spread (as a precision frame, recoil is already straight up and down), reduce charge speed with Accelerated Coils and then Feeding Frenzy, or Ensemble in a fireteam, to help with reload, and Repulsor Brace to give yourself an overshield when killing enemies with a void shield. Recommended MW: Stability, with a Backup Mag or damage-boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.

To Excess origin perk is most useful with Tier 4/5 supers with the shortest cooldown, but can add to melee/grenade builds. There are better void fusion rifles available but, if you must, use stability to constrain bolt spread (as a precision frame, recoil is already straight up and down), reduce charge speed with Accelerated Coils and then Feeding Frenzy, or Ensemble in a fireteam, to help with reload, and Swashbuckler (especially with Solar Titan bonk hammer) to boost damage against beefier champions and minibosses. Recommended MW: Stability or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag or damage-boosting (Minor, Major or Taken Spec) mod.
